title: Ramen Ron, The Matcha Tokyo launch limited-edition desserts
summary: Ramen Ron and The Matcha Tokyo Philippines have teamed up for a limited-edition menu featuring four desserts and a drink made with matcha and hojicha, available from Oct. 28 to Nov. 30.
